project_identity.title: Seaweed
project_identity.tagline: Limpieza de playas y protección de tortugas marinas
project_identity.theme: Retro 16-Bit Pixel Art Arcade & Environmental Impact Dashboard
project_identity.target_audience: Gamers, eco-enthusiasts, and community players aiming for high scores while supporting sea turtle conservation

colors.palette_name: Organic 16-Bit Tropical Beach & High Contrast Marine

visual_enhancers.pixel_button: border-b-4 border-r-4 border-[#1E110A] active:border-b-0 active:border-r-0 active:translate-y-1 transition-all

sound_effects.engine: Native Web Audio API (Oscillators, GainNodes, Envelopes)

layout_and_components.start_screen: NickName input form on rustic wood wooden sign, high score preview, how-to-play visual guide
layout_and_components.game_canvas: 16-bit Pixel Art Canvas with animated sea wave layers, crawling baby sea turtles on sandy shoreline, nesting site flags,falling items (bottles, cans, plastic rings, sargassum), player basket/boat
layout_and_components.hud: 7 Red pixel hearts (#FF4D4D) with black stroke, current score, combo multiplier, sound mute toggle
layout_and_components.controls: Keyboard A/D & Left/Right arrows + On-screen physical touch controls for mobile
layout_and_components.game_over_modal: Game summary, score submission confirmation, ecological fact popup, restart/leaderboard buttons
layout_and_components.impact_dashboard: Global stats (Total Games Played, Total Community Cleanup Count, Top 10 Leaderboard without dates/times)

privacy_rules.date_time: NEVER display dates or times on the public leaderboard or impact dashboard

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure pixel art CSS rendering rules are applied globally. Use Web Audio API for all retro game sounds. Persist player scores and metrics via FastAPI + MongoDB API. Ensure zero public dates/times are displayed on leaderboards.
